Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the function of antibodies, selecting option C ("Antibodies engulf the invading virus") which describes phagocytosis (a function of phagocytes like macrophages and neutrophils), rather than the actual function of antibodies which is to bind to antigens to mark them for destruction (opsonization) or neutralization. This represents a fundamental conceptual error regarding the immune system, where the agent confused the role of antibodies with the role of phagocytic cells.
